numerical_and_physical_gates.field_and_mode_outputs: full complex E/H plus all 600 channel amplitudes/powers; mode identity and completeness checked
numerical_and_physical_gates.comparison: The automatic same-discrete physical witness is the existing original 5 nm p6/h4/H6/p4-native run at results/euv_grazing1_phi0/original_5nm_si_p6h4_balanced_h6_p4_native__full3d_iterative__mpi1__Mna/20260911T065955.813489Z (source 85a681...; 3780 runtime cells/600 modes). Compare full same-discrete FE/EH/mode/R/T/A/A_volume observables under existing gates, not only a scalar residual. V6 F5 run 20261002T153058.967208Z (source 1828bc675f2862025e0eaed0beccf15982eb09e6) is a separate accepted performance/result comparison and is not an automatic direct p3-versus-V6-F5 pair gate.
numerical_and_physical_gates.comparison_boundary: If full reference field arrays are unavailable, report comparison partial; never infer full vector agreement from compact scalars.
numerical_and_physical_gates.official_outputs: Only outputs from a completed field passing all original full A6 and physical gates are qualified.

full_original_A6.gate: independent original full A6 relative true residual <= 1e-6
full_original_A6.actual_path: The retained runner _a6_fact/final packet applies runtime.fine[physical_action], the original native full p6 A6 action to the reconstructed/full field as required.
full_original_A6.separation: The fused A6 action used inside the PC is reported separately and does not replace the original native A6 qualification residual.

automatic_reference_policy.automatic_comparator: The existing old same-physical 5nm witness described in comparison_reference.same_discrete_physical_witness.
automatic_reference_policy.not_an_automatic_pair_gate: V6 F5 run 20261002T153058.967208Z is a separate accepted p4 performance/result record. It itself used the same old witness; this draft does not claim an automatic direct p3-vs-V6-F5 pair comparison.

same_discrete_physical_witness.role: Actual old same-physical full-field and 600-mode witness used by compare_retained_5nm_output.

numerical_output/dtn_port_diffraction_or.read_scope: existence/size checked; full modal values not parsed for this draft

same_discrete_physical_witness.historical_manifest_status_caveat: manifest status=launching is a historical placeholder; it is not the run terminal status or qualification receipt.

automatic_gates.selected_E_H_same_coordinates_complex_re: <=1e-4; exact coordinate identity; no phase fitting
automatic_gates.selected_E_H_near_zero: Retain existing comparator near-zero mask/absolute-difference reporting rule; do not invent a new threshold.

same_discrete_physical_witness.data_read_scope: Only small manifest/summary and required-file existence were checked for this draft; no large field/canonical arrays were read or compared.

accepted_v6_f5_performance_and_result_re.role: Separate accepted V6 p4 full-run/performance result; not the automatic p3 reference pair.
accepted_v6_f5_performance_and_result_re.reference_relationship: The V6 F5 itself passed against the old same-physical witness above; it is retained here as a separately qualified performance/result context.
